label: Kpower
description: This extension for Karoo devices adds a device simulates a virtual power meter.
releaseNotes: BREAKING CHANGE: general overhaul of the power estimation. 3-second power smoothing and slope filtering remove watt spikes, the FTP-scaled cap now uses realistic peak-over-FTP margins (1.2xFTP+130W), cadence gating has hysteresis, and tailwind handling is fixed. We recommend reviewing your profiles after updating.
